about.privacyBody: Free Speech runs on your device: your board, settings and usage are stored only in this browser (local storage). No data is sent to any server, no tracking cookies, no third-party analytics.
about.guideBody:
How the board works

  1. Colors with meaning (Fitzgerald key): tile color = grammar category — yellow = people/social words, green = verbs/actions, blue = adjectives/emotions, orange = nouns, white = misc. Teach the child: "green = doing, orange = things" — words are found by color, not position memory.
    People / SocialVerbsAdjectivesNounsMisc
  2. Core words first: the Main board orders the most-used words top-left; thematic collections extend vocabulary.
  3. Quick phrases: instant communication without building syntax — great for starting out or urgent moments.
  4. "Frequent" strip: shows the child's most-used pictograms for fast access.
  5. Word search: the bar search finds any pictogram in Spanish, English or German.

Device management

  1. Edit: pencil icon = edit mode (add via ARASAAC or own image, edit text/color, drag to reorder).
  2. Access code: enable in Settings so the child cannot edit — keep the PIN safe, no recovery.
  3. Voices: Settings → Voice lists all device voices; install a Spanish voice if missing.
  4. Size & contrast: pictogram size, tile size (big fingers) and high contrast for low vision.
  5. Backups: everything lives in the browser — Export regularly; Import copies the board to another device.
  6. Offline: fully offline after first load.
  7. Direct typing: with the A11Y PRO widget, pictograms type directly into web forms.

Teaching strategy

  1. Modeling: use the board yourself to talk to the child — they learn by watching use, not instruction.
  2. Start with 5-10 core words (want, more, no, like, go) and expand gradually.
  3. Respect all communication: gestures, sounds and the board count equally — the goal is to communicate.
  4. Personalize with their life: create pictograms with photos of family, classroom, therapist — personal vocabulary motivates.
about.heroBody: A11Y PRO SAS is a Colombian digital accessibility company. Free Speech is our open-source augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) board: ARASAAC pictograms, synthesized speech, word collections, direct typing into forms and offline-first — built for people with speech disabilities or cognitive communication needs.

about.docsBody:
Free Speech SAAC is an open-source Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) web app: ARASAAC pictogram board in 15 collections with Fitzgerald color coding, spoken sentence bar, word quick-search and a usage-based frequent strip.

  • Free & open-source forever (MIT license).
  • Offline: works fully offline after first load, pictograms included.
  • Embeddable floating window: freespeech-widget.js for any website or LMS with direct text insertion (Alt+Shift+S).
  • WCAG 2.2 AA accessible: Vue 3 + Vuetify 4 + Vite, screen readers, full keyboard navigation, editable boards, import/export.
  • Languages: Spanish, English, German.

Quick start: open freespeech.a11ypro.tech; on mobile use "Add to Home Screen". Developers: git clone, npm i in vueapp/, npm run dev / npm run build.

Embed the communicator on your site (customTrigger)

<button id="open-saac-btn">Open communicator</button>

<script
  src="https://freespeech.a11ypro.tech/freespeech-widget.js"
  data-saac-url="https://freespeech.a11ypro.tech/"
  data-custom-trigger="#open-saac-btn"
  data-show-default-trigger="true"
></script>
  • data-custom-trigger: selector of your button that toggles the window.
  • data-show-default-trigger: shows the built-in floating launcher.
  • JS API: FreeSpeechSAAC.open() / .toggle() / .close() and Alt+Shift+S.
  • Per-field buttons: data-saac-trigger + data-saac-target="#my-input" → text inserts directly into inputs, contenteditable and editors (TinyMCE, Quill, CKEditor).
  • Local demo: moodle-demo.html in the repo.
